lines.speaker: TAEO
lines.text: His crew does. They make surveys.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Hold that. I'll get the other wrench.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: Have you seen a place like this?

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Chae said you wanted work outside.

lines.speaker: TAEO
lines.text: If there's any I can do.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Carrying, equipment checks. Dispatch, once you know the job.

lines.speaker: TAEO
lines.text: Could I stay outside while he scouts?

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: I'd want to see where you're going first.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: We've got ten minutes before the next group. Show me how you talk to each other.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Get this to the other end. Scout the route, then talk him through it.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Walk. Nothing here is going to jump out.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Hold this to speak. Let go to listen.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: I went left. The gap at the end—

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: Why are you coming this way?

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Take it back. Let him finish looking.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: Take the right route. There's room all the way through.

lines.speaker: TAEO
lines.text: The right route. Do I start?

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: Wait. I'll come to the corner.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: Now. Tell me when you're through the first turn.

lines.speaker: TAEO
lines.text: First turn done. There's another left here.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: Yes. I'm at the far end.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: It did. But you stopped guessing.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: We're moving the screens this afternoon. I need someone to check the new route before the crews arrive tomorrow.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: Here. No gate. One hour, twenty thousand won. I'll be here the whole time.

lines.speaker: TAEO
lines.text: And I could do the radio?

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: You need more practice before you guide a crew.

lines.speaker: MINHO
lines.text: You can watch. Bring that assessment sheet.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: I didn't ask him to leave you out.

lines.speaker: TAEO
lines.text: I know. I wanted to be good at it.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: Then let me finish a sentence.

lines.speaker: NIB
lines.text: I'll ask what places they're surveying next.
